assistantlabs.headersHelper: if [ -f "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/scripts/auth-headers.cjs" ]; then node "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/scripts/auth-headers.cjs"; else T=$(sed -n 's/.*"accessToken"[[:space:]]*:[[:space:]]*"\([^"]*\)".*/\1/p' "$HOME/.assistantlabs/credentials.json" 2>/dev/null | head -1); if [ -n "$T" ]; then printf '{"Authorization":"Bearer %s"}' "$T"; else printf '{}'; fi; fi
